name: skill-router
description: Runs each skill and subagent on the right size of model, picked by Jev through OpenRouter and never above the session model. Shows each running subagent in a band above the chat box, with its model by colour and a progress bar, and on an Agents pane with how Jev chose the model. Gives each session conductor rules for handing work to subagents, and has a Fable agent review any turn that changed files before it ends. Logs every pick and review with its time and cost.
